meta.description: Sends celebration greetings for all 7 Hiren Kumar Long Island stores. Runs daily 9 AM EST. Fires at 7d, 3d, 1d before and day-of each event. Each store gets its own branded email + WhatsApp. Import into n8n, connect Gmail OAuth2 + Twilio credentials, activate.
